run_mode: native venv, served (openai endpoint + `vllm bench serve`, random dataset)
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 97887 MiB, single GPU (sm_120 / cc 12.0, 188 SMs)
model_desc: google/gemma-4-31B-it (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, model_type gemma4; 60 layers, hidden 5376, head_dim 256 / global_head_dim 512, 32 Q / 16 KV heads, sliding_window 1024, final_logit_softcapping 30.0)
attention_backend: TRITON_ATTN (forced: Gemma4 has heterogeneous head dims head_dim=256/global_head_dim=512, FA4 unavailable) — same in all three configs
cuda_graphs: ON (not --enforce-eager); cudagraph_mode FULL_AND_PIECEWISE; 'Graph capturing finished in 12-14 secs, took 0.77-0.84 GiB' in every config
sanity: per-config chat gate ('What is the capital of France?' -> 'The capital of France is Paris.'); coherent in all three configs
schema: each config.results row = {input_len, ttft_ms, prefill_tok_s, tpot_ms, itl_ms, decode_tok_s}
prefill_tok_s_convention: DERIVED as input_len / (Mean_TTFT_ms/1000) by the harness. vLLM bench serve reports no standalone prefill throughput; TTFT includes prefill + the first decode token + scheduling, so this slightly UNDER-reports true prefill tok/s. Kept for consistency with the repo's other served vLLM files (same derivation).
notes: Same harness as the 12B run (gemma4-12b-vllm-sm120.json): scratch copy of perf-data/bench_vllm_cuda.sh with ONE line changed — the hardcoded CUDA-12.8 PATH (line 58) replaced by PATH=/workspace/venvs/vllm/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH. No other harness change. Same CTXS/MAXLEN/GPU_UTIL for all three configs.
PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True set for all three configs (defensive against long-ctx fragmentation).

NO OOM and NO failed points: all 3 configs x 7 contexts (1k..128k) completed. bf16 is however TIGHT: 58.25 GiB ckpt weights leave only a 24.87 GiB / 191,862-token KV pool at util 0.90 — max concurrency 1.45x for a 132,096-token request. It fits (batch 1), but there is no bf16 headroom for batching at 128k on this card.
gpu-memory-utilization CONSTANT at 0.90 across all three configs, same as the 12B run — a clean A/B.
DECODE metric = tpot_ms (== itl_ms at concurrency 1). Lower is better; this is the campaign target.

ctx=1024 ttft_ms carries first-shape warm-up (torch.compile specialization / cudagraph capture for the smallest bench shape); a chat warm-up request precedes the sweep but the 1024 point still sees some of it. Decode TPOT is unaffected. 4k+ TTFT is clean.

ANOMALY (real, reproducible in all 3 prompts of the point): fp8kv decode TPOT jumps from 30.77 ms at 98k to 38.63 ms at 128k — WORSE than plain fp8's 36.13 ms at 128k, the only ctx where fp8kv loses. Median 38.41 / P99 39.39, so it is a steady-state regime of the TRITON_ATTN fp8-KV decode kernel at >98k ctx, not a preemption blip (serve log has zero preemptions). fp8kv TTFT at 128k is still 4.3x better than fp8 (20.6 s vs 89.0 s).

bf16/fp8 long-ctx TTFT collapses hard on this model (bf16 128k = 99.6 s, fp8 = 89.0 s): the 512-dim global-attention layers dominate quadratic prefill at 60 layers. fp8kv holds 6.3-6.4k derived prefill tok/s from 64k up.
fp8kv config logs 'Checkpoint does not provide a q scaling factor. Setting it to k_scale' — harmless here (only matters for FP8 flash-attn/flashinfer attention backends; this run is TRITON_ATTN).
Every GPU-touching command ran inside `gpulease b1-31b ...`; one lease per config spanning serve -> sweep -> shutdown -> VRAM drain. No server ever ran outside a lease.

configs.sanity_generated: The capital of France is Paris.
notes: 58.25 GiB ckpt on a 96 GB card: full 128k fits at util 0.90 but only 1.45x concurrency — the 12B's 12.63x headroom does not exist here. No OOM anywhere in the sweep.
bf16 TTFT at 128k is 99.6 s — prefill throughput decays from 5.8k tok/s (4k) to 1.3k tok/s (128k).

configs.config_desc: fp8 weight-only (--quantization fp8, dynamic e4m3 from the bf16 ckpt)
configs.sanity_generated: The capital of France is Paris.
notes: fp8 weights free ~27 GiB vs bf16 (available KV 24.87 -> 52.22 GiB); decode TPOT -35% to -43% vs bf16 across the ladder.

configs.config_desc: fp8 weights + fp8 KV cache (--quantization fp8 --kv-cache-dtype fp8)
configs.sanity_generated: The capital of France is Paris.
notes: Same 52.22 GiB KV pool holds 805,704 tokens (exactly 2x fp8's 402,842).
fp8kv's long-ctx TTFT win is huge on this model: 128k TTFT 20.6 s vs fp8 89.0 s (-77%) and bf16 99.6 s (-79%).

128k decode ANOMALY: TPOT 38.63 ms, up from 30.77 ms at 98k and worse than fp8's 36.13 ms — the only point on the ladder where fp8kv loses decode. Consistent across the point's 3 prompts (median 38.41, P99 39.39); no preemption in the serve log.
